settings.hero_heading: Rooted in Botany. Proven by Science.
settings.hero_subheading: KUS CULTURE was born in Melbourne from a simple realization: conventional hair care too often strips the scalp microbiome with sulfates or coats it in heavy silicones. We bio-engineered a clinical clean alternative.

settings.title: Targeted Peptides
settings.description: We formulate with Biotinoyl Tripeptide-1 and Copper GHK-Cu peptides that strengthen the laminin-5 sheath anchoring hair shafts into the dermis.

settings.title: Native Australian Botanicals
settings.description: Sustainably harvested Australian Kakadu Plum, Organic Rosemary CO2 extract, and Macadamia lipids provide bio-available antioxidants without synthetic perfume.

settings.title: Microbiome Defense
settings.description: All formulas are calibrated to pH 5.2–5.5, preserving natural lipid acid mantle defense against flakes, irritation, and premature follicular shedding.
